Strict stubs report unused stubs and stubs whose arguments don't match a call, but they don't require every interaction to be verified, so a verifyNoMoreInteractions check is still your own choice. The Strictness documentation should say this plainly, and it's a fair docs fix. Related work on strict mocks is tracked in #1097.
